qa_pair.question: The Rachio account has several devices. Not all of them are physical irrigation controllers. How many SENSOR_LINKED devices are attached to the account?
Find the irrigation controller on the account and report its model string exactly as the API returns it.
The controller has a Koppen climate classification stored with it. Report the Koppen code as a single string.
The controller is in a specific USDA plant hardiness zone. Report the zone as the API returns it.
Look across all the zones configured on the controller. How many of them are currently disabled?
Across the enabled zones on the controller, how many distinct nozzle types are in use? (A zone's nozzle type is reported in its zone_detail.)
List every watering schedule on the controller and count only those whose annual-recurring window starts in April.
One schedule on the controller is configured to run on more than one day of the week. What is that schedule's name? Answer with exactly the name as stored, no quotes.
The controller has two RAIN sensors wired into it. One is in SLOT_ONE, the other in SLOT_TWO. Are either of them enabled? Answer "yes" if at least one is enabled, otherwise "no".
Look up the virtual weather station associated with the account's location. It has a station identifier (a Weather Underground PWS ID). Report that station_id exactly.
